name: Desa Kitsune
description: is a unique lifestyle village and hospitality concept located in the heart of Canggu, Bali. It is a world-first destination by the French-Japanese lifestyle brand Kitsuné, which seamlessly blends food, fashion, culture, and music into an immersive experience. Every Tuesday and Friday, Desa Kitsuné hosts its signature soirée — a lively night featuring Bali’s top DJs and international guest artists, creating one of the island’s most iconic party experiences.
